skills.name: academic-literature-search
skills.title: 学术文献检索
skills.description: 检索、筛选和核验中英文学术文章，输出相关性说明、可追溯来源及 BibTeX 引用。 用于查论文、找相关研究、了解研究进展、补充参考文献，以及按需查找主张的文献证据。

skills.name: academic-paper-translator
skills.title: 英文学术文献翻译
skills.description: 将数学、物理、计算机领域的英文学术文献忠实翻译为简体中文，支持 PDF、Word、网页和粘贴文本，保留公式与图表，默认交付中文 Word 和 PDF。 用于英文论文翻译、文献汉化、整篇或指定章节翻译；长文可由多个 subagent 分工。单纯文献检索、摘要提炼或论文润色不触发本技能。

skills.name: academic-paper-writing
skills.title: 科研论文写作
skills.description: 起草、修改和点评中英文学术论文（academic paper writing / scientific writing），按需拆解范文并建立有出处的句式库。 适用于科研论文的章节写作、结构诊断与写作训练；单纯文献检索、论文翻译或竞赛论文排版使用对应专项 skill。

skills.name: anti-defensive-writing
skills.title: 反防御性写作
skills.description: 起草或修订论文、摘要、引言、讨论及技术说明时，删去重复自我否定、无信息免责声明和层叠保留语，直接表达有证据的观点；保留影响结论成立的假设、范围、方法限制和真实不确定性。

skills.name: astra-delegate
skills.title: Astra 协助
skills.description: 在用户请求 Astra 协助证明、审查或分析时，优先使用可用的 Codex Astra 子 Agent；需要使用用户自己的 OpenAI Platform API 时，执行独立的 Astra 模型咨询。

skills.name: cnki-search
skills.title: CNKI Reference Search
skills.description: 在中国知网（CNKI）上检索学术论文并导出参考文献。Use when Codex needs to find CNKI papers, search Chinese academic literature, retrieve paper metadata/details/references, or produce GB/T 7714-style citations from queries mentioning 知网, CNKI, 中国知网, 文献检索, 论文搜索, 参考文献, 期刊论文, 学位论文, or 会议论文.

skills.name: euclidean-tensor-geometry
skills.title: 欧几里得张量几何
skills.description: Apply or audit OpenAI family 379 Euclidean tensor prices, Strassen spectral invariants, and common-placement network bounds in arithmetic complexity and combinatorics. 中文触发：欧几里得张量几何、张量价格、渐近谱、跨割下界。Do not use for generic tensor numerics or classical maximal operators without a proved model bridge.

skills.name: ipad-math-node
skills.title: iPad 数学计算节点
skills.description: 通过 USB 数据线使用 iPad Math Node 应用执行支持的数学计算；核验设备和应用状态，提交有界任务并保存实际结果。适用于用户要求利用 iPad CPU 辅助研究。

skills.name: literature-download
skills.title: 兼容入口：literature-download
skills.description: 兼容按题录或 DOI 清单批量下载文献的旧入口；使用 literature-search-download 的按清单获取流程。

skills.name: literature-search-download
skills.title: 文献检索与下载
skills.description: 检索中英文学术文献、核验题录与版本、下载可获取的论文全文，交付 PDF、BibTeX 和可追溯清单。用于“找论文并下载”、按 DOI/题名/文献表批量获取全文，也支持只检索或只下载；不自动扩展为论文翻译或系统综述。

skills.name: local-hybrid-math
skills.title: 本机 CPU / GPU 协同数学计算
skills.description: 合理调度本机 CPU 与 GPU，实测并优化 MATLAB、Mathematica/Wolfram Language、Python 的矩阵、数组、FFT、批量模拟等数学计算。用于 Apple Silicon/Metal、PyTorch MPS、GPUArray/gpuArray、加速、线程数、内存与精度问题；按规模、精度和含传输的实测耗时选择后端，保存运行证据，MATLAB 用后及时关闭。

Use for centered-cube-upper-bound, the Round 830 remainder, or cubical endpoint constants; not for Euclidean balls, Kakeya tubes, or strong rectangular maxima.

skills.title: M02 · Hahn–Banach 分离与支撑函数证书
skills.description: 构造 Hahn–Banach 分离或支撑函数证书，检查闭性、拓扑和分离方向。

skills.name: math-m03-near-extremizer-stability
skills.title: M03 · 近极值稳定性与刚性
skills.description: 分析近极值稳定性与刚性，核对亏损量、对称性、距离和紧性缺口。

skills.name: math-m04-measurable-supremum-selection
skills.title: M04 · 可测上确界、解析投影与合法选择器
skills.description: 处理可测上确界、解析投影和可测选择，核对参数空间、可测性及选择器范围。

skills.name: math-m05-cut-metric-construction
skills.title: M05 · 有限 cut 与 Lp 度量构造
skills.description: 在有限树分解上拼接二元 cut law，构造嵌套 cut 坐标图，或把有限 Lp 度量精确离散到有限坐标，核对边缘、零质量、重参数化与距离公式。

skills.name: math-modeling-audit

skills.description: 审计数学建模竞赛项目的模型假设、算法结论、实验账本与论文数值，恢复多版本项目的可信状态。适用于检查建模结果是否可靠、核对论文与代码数据、区分历史重算和新实验、定位证据缺口；不用于单纯论文排版或替代用户开展新实验。

skills.name: math-modeling-delivery
skills.title: 数学建模结果表达与支撑交付
skills.description: 将数学建模结果组织为题目要求的 Excel、论文图表、附录和可复现支撑包。适用于核对输出采样与精度、同步结果及源码、清理重复材料、制作 ZIP/RAR 和提交前一致性核验；不自动代签、上传或重跑正式实验。

skills.name: math-modeling-paper
skills.title: 数学建模论文排版与局部修订
skills.description: 编排或局部修订中文数学建模竞赛论文，处理页数口径、页码与页脚、摘要精确加粗、图表位置、附录及 PDF 最小改动验收。适用于保留指定基线格式、修复大块空白、按 Word 标注修改摘要或生成数学建模排版提示词；不用于改写未经授权的模型结论。

skills.name: math-n01-john-loewner-ellipsoid
skills.title: N01 · John、Löwner 椭球与容量
skills.description: 使用 John 或 Löwner 椭球与容量方法，核对凸体假设、归一化和常数依赖。

skills.name: math-n02-log-concave-marginal-inequalities
skills.title: N02 · Prékopa–Leindler、BBL 与对数凹边际
skills.description: 核验 Prékopa–Leindler、BBL 与对数凹边际不等式，检查指数、积分和等号条件。

skills.name: math-n03-oscillation-and-geometric-remainder
skills.title: N03 · 振荡抵消与几何余项（van der Corput、半密度）
skills.description: 分析 van der Corput、半密度与振荡抵消的几何余项，核对相位和一致参数范围。

skills.name: math-n04-summable-error-entropy-descent
skills.title: N04 · 可求和误差管理与熵递减
skills.description: 组织可求和误差与熵递减论证，检查逐层预算、收敛传递和累计误差。

skills.name: math-n05-translative-covering-density
skills.title: N05 · 凸体平移覆盖密度
skills.description: 用带缓冲的窗口周期化研究凸体平移覆盖密度。适用于从有限基本域证明覆盖上界、从所有有限余类的排除推出下界，以及核对重叠计数、余类去重和单格点阵的同步剪切与补全。

skills.name: math-n06-projection-body-volume
skills.title: N06 · 投影体体积
skills.description: 审查投影体的未极化体积泛函、凸多面体的直积恒等式与一阶变分测度。适用于构造或核对投影体体积比、单纯形比较及椭球下界接口。

skills.name: math-n07-pair-energy-fourier-bounds
skills.title: N07 · Fourier pair-energy lower bounds
skills.description: Derive lower bounds for planar pair energies from Fourier-positive Schwartz minorants and transfer all Gaussian bounds to nonnegative completely monotone potentials. Use for locally finite configurations with centered disk density, including singular potentials and extended energies.

skills.name: math-n08-ruled-cylinder-finite-approximation
skills.title: N08 · 受控线段扫掠的有限柱面逼近
skills.description: 将带迹零、非椭圆横向微分的三维线段扫掠转成有限柱面覆盖，并核对垂直底面积。适用于有限化可变方向线段族，不用于一般柱面覆盖猜想或任意速度场。

skills.name: math-n09-soft-slab-variance
skills.title: N09 · 软 slab 势的矩坐标方差
skills.description: 对偶次线性形式的强凸软 slab 势构造或审查方差界。核对矩坐标证书、逐项 Hessian 正性与张量估计，输出可用于参数对数凹性的有限维方差结论。

skills.name: math-n10-dirichlet-slab-energy
skills.title: N10 · Dirichlet 条带能量
skills.description: 用中心高斯路径相关估算凸域加入多条带约束的 Dirichlet 本征值代价，并由所有对角权重的界构造同一个逐坐标能量见证。

skills.name: math-openai-arithmetic-determinants
skills.title: 算术行列式构造与验收
skills.description: 从 OpenAI 算术预印本提取 Taylor 接触消元、整数多项式行构造、行列式算术下界与解析上界比较。用于设计或审查 Catalan 常数、π 与欧拉常数研究中的行列式候选。

skills.name: math-paper-writing
skills.title: 数学论文写作
skills.description: 以用户提供的《数学论文写作规范_动机结构与自然表达》PDF 为准，起草、修改和点评中英文数学研究论文，落实文章结构、方法动机、证明与自然表达，检查量词和计算证据。 尤其适用于调和分析、极大算子、概率与随机过程、几何分析、优化及计算辅助证明；纯文献检索、逐篇翻译和单纯竞赛排版使用对应技能。

skills.name: math-research
skills.title: 数学研究总入口
skills.description: 统筹数学研究、证明核验与计算实验：按问题选择数学方法和概率专题，衔接数学计算、文献、写作和交付技能。研究任务需要确定方法和执行工具时使用；单纯语言润色与普通电脑操作使用各自技能。

skills.name: math-sondow-log-fractional-certificate
skills.title: Sondow 对数分数部分证书
skills.description: 从 Sondow 的双积分与对数线性形式构造可严格计算的欧拉常数分母排除证书。用于生成 S_n 对数权重、认证分数部分阈值、估计余项或寻找使判据在无穷多个指标成立的方法。

skills.name: math-tool-router
skills.title: 数学工具引导
skills.description: 按任务、精度和实际可用性调用本机数学工具，执行或核验数学推导、符号计算、数值计算、优化及计算实验。适用于在 Python、MATLAB、Mathematica/Wolfram、本机 CPU/GPU 和已授权设备间选路，也支持直接指定工具。

skills.name: mathematica-math
skills.title: Mathematica 数学计算与验证
skills.description: 用 Mathematica/Wolfram Language 进行可复现的数学符号推导、数值计算、优化与绘图，并核验结果；数学任务需要实际调用 Mathematica 时使用，不用于一般 Notebook 编辑。

skills.description: 使用本机 MATLAB 实际运行脚本，制作或修改论文与数学建模图；支持 CSV、Excel、MAT 和公式，检查中文、公式与排版，交付 PNG/PDF、可编辑 FIG 和可复现 .m 源码。用户要求 MATLAB 绘图、论文图美化、多子图或已有 MATLAB 图修改时使用。

skills.name: pdf-paper-translate

skills.description: 兼容学术论文 PDF 翻译的旧入口；转入 academic-paper-translator，保留指定的输出格式与排版要求。

skills.name: probability-analytic-endpoint-methods
skills.title: Analytic endpoint methods
skills.description: Audit weak-type endpoints, Lorentz and Hardy endpoint methods, and Riesz-transform claims by matching exact input class, output norm, domain, and theorem hypotheses.

skills.name: probability-bandit-information-bounds
skills.title: Bandit information bounds
skills.description: Analyze stochastic bandit regret and best-arm identification using KL change of measure, structured alternatives, RKHS confidence regions, and sampling allocations; use for direct Bernoulli-mean kernel bandits or fixed-budget versus fixed-confidence distinctions.

skills.name: probability-bernoulli-extremal-orders
skills.title: Bernoulli extremalization and order checks
skills.description: Audit independent Bernoulli sums, fixed-mean and fixed-moment extrema, dependence-sensitive convex order, log-concavity, exact tail comparisons, and approximation budgets.

skills.name: probability-bernoulli-factory
skills.title: Bernoulli-factory analysis
skills.description: Select and audit exact coin factories, fixed-depth event representations, and random-stopping constructions with assumptions, output types, and cost clocks explicit.

skills.name: probability-boolean-fourier-invariance
skills.title: Boolean Fourier, influence, noise, and invariance
skills.description: Analyze Boolean-cube Fourier, coordinate influence, noise stability, low-influence invariance, and bounded-independence PTF questions. Use when the model is a Boolean function or product-space polynomial transfer; use the Gaussian approximation skill for sharp Hermite or Gaussian sign-approximation constants.

skills.name: probability-brownian-potential-fractals
skills.title: Brownian path, potential, and coupling methods
skills.description: Analyze Brownian path sets, planar SLE and loop-erasure interfaces, potential-capacity comparisons, or reflected Brownian couplings using the exact source scopes in the accompanying references.

skills.name: probability-concentration-chaining
skills.title: Concentration, large deviations, and chaining
skills.description: Apply and audit concentration inequalities, large-deviation bounds, empirical-process/chaining estimates, and anti-concentration results while preserving model assumptions and the distinction between upper tails and small-ball bounds.

skills.name: probability-determinantal-dependence
skills.title: Determinantal dependence and measure singularity
skills.description: Audit determinantal laws, negative dependence, and singularity claims for spanning-tree and forest measures.

skills.name: probability-first-passage-growth
skills.title: First-passage percolation and growth models
skills.description: Analyze first-passage percolation, geodesics and Busemann functions, random growth and competition, and max-flow questions when the exact weight law, lattice, dimension, or direction hypotheses matter.

skills.name: probability-flow-poset-growth
skills.title: Directed flow, poset covers and sparse growth
skills.description: Audit finite directed capacity flows, edge-disjoint path covers, Dilworth chain covers, LIS/RSK and sparse Poisson growth; keep boundary, model and double-limit hypotheses explicit.

skills.name: probability-forests-electrical-networks
skills.title: Probability on forests and electrical networks
skills.description: Analyze uniform and minimal spanning forests, electrical networks, mass transport, unimodular random networks, and related finite spanning-tree inequalities.

skills.name: probability-gaussian-polynomial-approximation
skills.title: Gaussian polynomial and Hermite approximation
skills.description: Analyze Hermite expansions, Gaussian polynomial moments and tails, anti-concentration, and approximation of Gaussian sign or indicator functions. Use when the input is a real polynomial under standard Gaussian measure; keep low-influence invariance and PTF boundary results within their stated hypotheses.

skills.name: probability-generating-function-boundaries
skills.title: Probability Generating Functions and Complex Boundary Methods
skills.description: Audit two-dimensional queue-length PGF equations and complex boundary reductions while preserving event epochs, empty-boundary terms, analytic hypotheses, and probability admissibility.

skills.name: probability-harmonic-measure-coding
skills.title: Harmonic measures, tree boundaries, and coding comparisons
skills.description: Analyze harmonic and boundary measures on trees, symbolic codings, exact dimensions, and equivalence versus singularity of pushforward measures on a common metric space.

skills.name: probability-infection-witness-methods
skills.title: Infection witnesses and closure certificates
skills.description: Build and audit finite causal witnesses for deterministic monotone infection closures, with separate model routes for random-set zero forcing, synchronous graph-H bootstrap, and Hamming-plane Young growth.

skills.name: probability-information-cluster-expansion
skills.title: Probability: information, renewal, and expansions
skills.description: Analyze entropy-rate variational problems, synchronization and deletion-channel capacity, renewal polling limits, and convergence of cluster or asymptotic expansions.

skills.name: probability-integer-polynomial-factorization
skills.title: Integer convolution and 0–1 polynomial factors
skills.description: Analyze finite-support integer convolution through probability-generating polynomials, monic nonnegative-real factors, and exact bounded algebraic certificates; preserve support gaps and coefficient-domain assumptions.

skills.name: probability-logconcave-moment-geometry
skills.title: Log-concave moments and convex geometry
skills.description: Analyze moment comparisons, centroid-body expansion, convex geometry, and transport or functional inequalities for log-concave laws.

skills.name: probability-markov-spectral-mixing
skills.title: Markov spectral gaps and Ising Glauber dynamics
skills.description: Analyze finite reversible Markov-chain mixing and spectral gaps, especially heat-bath Glauber dynamics for ferromagnetic Ising models; use when a claim depends on update clocks, graph geometry, or correlation inequalities.

skills.name: probability-martingale-stopping
skills.title: Martingales, stopping, and stochastic integration
skills.description: Analyze martingales, stopping rules, maximal inequalities, stochastic integrals, and martingale-problem limits with explicit filtration and integrability checks.

skills.name: probability-measure-convergence
skills.title: Probability measures and convergence
skills.description: Analyze weak convergence, tightness, conditional laws, changing integrands, and martingale-problem limits. Use when a proof passes from stochastic models to limits of probability measures or needs a precise convergence mode.

skills.name: probability-moment-polynomial-duality
skills.title: Finite moments and polynomial duality
skills.description: Build finite-support probability bounds for Boolean k-wise laws, event/count moment data, and degree-bounded polynomial duals. Use when the support and full constrained marginal or moment map can be stated; route Fourier and invariance proofs to the existing Boolean skill, and treat tensor/tree recursion as uncovered here.

skills.name: probability-nonlinear-law-dynamics
skills.title: Nonlinear probability-law dynamics
skills.description: Analyze fixed points and iteration of probability-law operators, including nested stationary-law maps, nonlinear Markov updates, and recursive distributional equations; use when the proof needs operator-specific existence, uniqueness, stability, or global convergence.

skills.name: probability-optimization-certificates
skills.title: Probability optimization certificates
skills.description: Build and audit finite-dimensional optimization bounds and proof certificates used inside probability arguments, including duality, interval validation, and exact LP/MIP checks.

skills.name: probability-percolation-renormalization
skills.title: Percolation and renormalization methods
skills.description: Analyze iid percolation, finite-range block arguments, bootstrap closure, and random-host propagation only after matching the model, observable, and hypotheses to an exact source interface.

skills.name: probability-permutation-subset-sums
skills.title: Permutation cycles and random subset sums
skills.description: Analyze invariant k-subsets of random permutations through cycle counts, Poisson limits, and random subset-sum reachability while keeping fixed-k limits separate from adjacent-k monotonicity.

skills.name: probability-planar-isoperimetry
skills.title: Planar graph isoperimetry and discrete curvature
skills.description: Analyze isoperimetric profiles and curvature methods on planar graphs or tessellations when the boundary statistic, embedding, and theorem hypotheses can be matched.

skills.name: probability-poset-counting-sampling
skills.title: Poset counting and exact sampling
skills.description: Count linear extensions and related finite poset families, derive entropy bounds, or build exact samplers; also use for finite graph-labeling peak constraints that admit a verifiable counting recurrence.

skills.name: probability-prophet-online-selection
skills.title: Prophet inequalities and online selection
skills.description: Analyze prophet inequalities, optimal thresholds, online resource allocation, and stochastic matching while preserving the arrival model and benchmark.

skills.name: probability-queueing-heavy-traffic
skills.title: Queueing stability and heavy traffic
skills.description: Analyze queueing-network stability and heavy-traffic limits using fluid/Lyapunov methods, polling models, state-space collapse, BAR, and reflected diffusions. Renewal/Palm epoch conversion and exact coupling/total-variation questions are out of scope here.

skills.name: probability-random-graph-energy-landscapes
skills.title: Evidence and scope
skills.description: Analyze synchronization, phase-locking, and energy-landscape claims for graph-coupled oscillator models; choose a theorem only when its graph, coupling, symmetry, quotient, and probability hypotheses match.

skills.name: probability-random-matrix-tensor
skills.title: Random matrices, tensors, and noncommutative martingales
skills.description: Prove or audit random matrix and tensor norm bounds, Banach type-2 estimates, and noncommutative martingale inequalities. Use when the norm, covariance model, or row/column square-function assumptions need precise source-based checking.

skills.name: probability-random-recursive-trees-asymptotics
skills.title: Random recursive-tree asymptotics
skills.description: Analyze asymptotic moments, profiles, fringe statistics, and limit laws for size-dependent or recursively grown random trees while preserving the construction, sampling rule, and theorem hypotheses.

skills.name: probability-random-spatial-tree-geometry
skills.title: Random spatial networks, tree walks, and boundary measures
skills.description: Route questions across spatial network geometry, random-tree walks and boundary measures only after fixing the exact model; use the locally scoped, independently reviewed theorem interfaces and keep open maximum, monotonicity, and cross-model transfers explicit.

skills.name: probability-reflected-diffusion-coupling
skills.title: Reflected diffusion couplings
skills.description: Model and audit couplings of reflected diffusions when boundary geometry, the coupling class, coalescence, meeting tails, or Neumann spectra affect the proof.

skills.name: probability-renewal-palm-coupling
skills.title: Renewal, Palm, and exact coupling
skills.description: Analyze renewal and Palm sampling, queueing recurrence and stationary limits, and when a coupling yields exact or total-variation convergence.

skills.name: probability-self-avoiding-walks-and-sle
skills.title: Evidence state
skills.description: Analyze rigorous self-avoiding-walk growth and graph methods, and audit proposed links from planar lattice walks to continuum SLE.

skills.name: probability-spectral-perturbation-certificates
skills.title: Spectral perturbation and strict gap certificates
skills.description: Audit finite-dimensional parameter-dependent eigenvalues and reversible Markov spectral gaps, including changing stationary measures, crossings, Poisson response, and rigorous interval enclosures.

skills.name: probability-stationary-law-interfaces
skills.title: Stationary-law interfaces
skills.description: Prove or audit stationary laws for Markov environments, tree flows, IPS and drift-jump systems; use for generator/core, flux, coupling, Palm/occupation, regeneration, or projective-limit arguments.

skills.name: probability-stochastic-geometry-localization
skills.title: Stochastic geometry, coverage, and localization
skills.description: Prove or audit Poisson growing-ball cover-time and spatial-network localization claims, including measure optimization, Poissonization, and boundary tails, while checking the exact model and transfer hypotheses.

skills.name: probability-variational-limits
skills.title: Probability variational limits
skills.description: Audit limits of stochastic optimization values, expectations, minimax problems, and selected optimizer laws; match weak convergence, uniform integrability, Gamma convergence, LDP/Laplace principles, and second-parameter estimates to their exact hypotheses.

skills.name: python-math

skills.description: 使用本机 Python 实际执行数学运算、SymPy 符号推导、NumPy/SciPy 数值计算与优化、有限枚举及结果验证；先选择已有解释器和数学库，再保存脚本、运行并检查结果。用户要求用 Python 跑计算或研究任务适合 Python 时使用。

skills.name: remote-math-compute
